```{r}
install.packages("nycflights13")
library(nycflights13)
glimpse(flights)

flights |> 
  filter(month == 1)

flights |> 
  filter(month == 1 & day == 1)

flights |> 
  arrange(year, month, day, dep_time)

flights |> 
  arrange(desc(month))
```
```{r}
i < flights |> 
filter(arr_delay > 120 & dep_delay <= 0) 
  arrange(dep_delay)
  
j < flights |> 
  arrange(dep_delay) |> 
  filter(arr_delay > 120 & dep_delay <= 0) 

all(i==j)
```
